programme_facts.value: First you should consider a school’s location. Do you want to go to college nearby or out of state? You should then find out if a school you are interested in offers the degree program you want to study. Also consider what type of financial aid you might expect to receive. Finally, take a tour of the campus to help you decide if the school is a good fit for you.
